atlas: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Ganger profession icon for a post-apocalyptic tabletop interface, displayed at 16-64 pixels. Create ONE square image containing ONE compact emblem with exactly TWO complete objects: an EMPTY SLEEVELESS BIKER LEATHER VEST at LEFT, and ONE STUDDED BASEBALL BAT standing diagonally beside it at RIGHT. The reference is STYLE ONLY: match its sober broad white stencil weight and simplicity, never its subjects or nine-cell layout. Vest: simple slightly turned THREE-QUARTER FRONT VIEW, showing two broad white front panels, an open black center gap, two broad turned lapels and clearly open armholes. EMPTY garment, no body, head, arms, hanger or person inside it. Keep the garment silhouette coherent, with a simple hem and very few large black cuts; no pockets, buttons, zipper teeth, stitching, badge, lettering or logo. Bat: ONE recognizable complete smooth broad blunt barrel tapering into ONE short stout grip with ONE rounded end knob. Only THREE short broad studs project from the upper barrel, clearly part of that object; no tiny nails or holes. Angle the bat from LOWER-LEFT to UPPER-RIGHT on the vest's RIGHT, with a generous uninterrupted BLACK GAP separating the two objects. They do NOT cross or overlap. This conveys gang membership and blunt close combat. Pure SOLID WHITE #FFFFFF on perfectly clean SOLID BLACK #000000; no grey, shading, gradients, dithering, texture or speckling. Broad sober utilitarian silhouettes with sparse large negative spaces, readable at 16/24/32 pixels. Center both complete objects together in the middle 65 percent of the image with generous blank margins on all sides. No wheel, tire, spokes, circular frame, geometric alignment puzzle, motorcycle, skull, extra prop, gruff face, anime, cartoon anatomy, blood, gore, text, numbers, decorative border or grid.
layout: One isolated replacement, composited unchanged into cell 1 of a black 3x3 canvas for existing processor compatibility; eight empty cells.

canonicalRationale.reason: Jeden z nich establishes gang membership; Dwoch na jednego and Ja i moj gang establish gang melee. Empty biker clothing and a blunt weapon express those roles without a portrait or wheel.
